title: juncus acutus subsp. decompositus
intro: Juncus acutus subsp. decompositus, commonly known as Salt Rush or Needle Rush, is a type of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Juncus acutus subsp. decompositus include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
